subject: spanish
promptStrong: Give me a 40-word writing task in Spanish on {lo} for {board} {level} {subject}, then mark my answer for accuracy and range.
promptWeak: Give me a two-way translation drill (Spanish↔English) on {lo} for {board} {level} {subject}, with answers and the common mistakes to avoid.

questions.q: How do you say 'I get on well with my sister'?
options: Me llevo bien con mi hermana
questions.explain: 'Llevarse bien con' means 'to get on well with', so 'Me llevo bien con mi hermana' = 'I get on well with my sister'.

questions.q: What does 'mi hermano mayor' mean?
questions.explain: 'Mayor' means 'older/elder', so 'mi hermano mayor' = 'my older brother'. 'Menor' would mean younger.

questions.q: How would you write 'simpático' to describe two girls?
questions.explain: Adjectives agree with the noun: feminine plural takes -as, so two girls are 'simpáticas'.

questions.q: Which sentence means 'My parents are divorced'?
questions.explain: Marital state uses 'estar': 'Mis padres están divorciados'. 'Casados' would mean married.

questions.q: What does 'Es un buen amigo en quien puedo confiar' mean?
options: He is a good friend whom I can trust
He is a friend I argue with
He is a friend I rarely see
He is a friend who lies to me
questions.explain: 'Confiar en' means 'to trust', so the sentence means 'He is a good friend whom I can trust'.

questions.q: How do you say 'I have brown hair and green eyes'?
options: Tengo el pelo castaño y los ojos verdes
Tengo el pelo verde y los ojos castaños
Soy el pelo castaño y los ojos verdes
Tengo el pelo castaña y los ojos verde
questions.explain: Use 'tener' for features and agree adjectives: 'el pelo castaño' (masc.) and 'los ojos verdes' (masc. plural).

questions.q: What does 'llevar una vida sana' mean?
questions.explain: 'Sano/a' means 'healthy', so 'llevar una vida sana' = 'to lead a healthy life'.

questions.q: Which sentence means 'You must avoid sugary drinks'?
options: Hay que evitar las bebidas azucaradas
questions.explain: 'Hay que' = 'one must' and 'evitar' = 'to avoid', so 'Hay que evitar las bebidas azucaradas' = 'You must avoid sugary drinks'.

questions.q: What does 'el tabaquismo' mean?
questions.explain: 'El tabaquismo' is the habit/addiction of smoking, not a shop (that would be 'el estanco').

questions.q: How do you say 'I do exercise to keep fit'?
options: Hago ejercicio para mantenerme en forma
Hago ejercicio porque estoy en forma
Hace ejercicio para mantenerme en forma
questions.explain: 'Mantenerse en forma' = 'to keep fit' and 'para' = 'in order to'; 'hago' is the correct first-person form.

questions.q: What does 'el bienestar' mean?
questions.explain: 'El bienestar' literally means 'being well' and translates as 'wellbeing'.

questions.q: What does 'el aprobado' mean?
questions.explain: 'Aprobar' means 'to pass', so 'el aprobado' is a pass grade. A fail is 'el suspenso'.

questions.q: Which sentence means 'I have to revise for my exams'?
options: Tengo que repasar para mis exámenes
Tengo que faltar a mis exámenes
questions.explain: 'Repasar' means 'to revise' and 'tener que' = 'to have to', so this means 'I have to revise for my exams'.

questions.q: What does 'la asignatura' mean?
questions.explain: 'La asignatura' is a false friend: it means 'school subject', not 'signature' (which is 'la firma').

questions.q: How do you say 'I would like to be a nurse'?
questions.explain: 'Me gustaría' (conditional) = 'I would like' and 'enfermero' = 'nurse'; 'enfermo' means 'ill', a near-miss distractor.

questions.q: What does 'el desempleo' mean?
questions.explain: 'El desempleo' (also 'el paro') means 'unemployment'; 'el empleo' is 'employment/a job'.

questions.q: Which sentence means 'Yesterday I studied a lot' (past)?
questions.explain: 'Estudié' is the preterite (completed past) 'I studied'; with 'ayer' (yesterday) the preterite is correct.

questions.q: How would you write 'trabajador' to describe a hard-working woman?
questions.explain: Adjectives ending in -dor add -a for the feminine singular, so a hard-working woman is 'trabajadora'.

questions.q: Which means 'I am tired' (right now)?
questions.explain: Temporary states use 'estar': 'Estoy cansado'. 'Casado' means married, a near-miss spelling distractor.

questions.q: What does 'estoy embarazada' mean?
questions.explain: 'Embarazada' is a classic false friend: it means 'pregnant', not 'embarrassed' (which is 'avergonzado/a').
